purpose: Separate broker-structural coverage from economic discovery and align information acquisition with realizable portfolio-level equity growth.

stage_2.name: MECHANISM_SPECIFIC_CANDIDATE_SELECTION
stage_2.rule: Freeze candidate scope using outcome-blind family-specific selection. Families do not share a mandatory panel.

TREND_MOMENTUM.confirmation: blocked_or_walk_forward; portfolio-level aggregation permitted when predeclared

MEAN_REVERSION.confirmation: event-cluster-aware; no mandatory per-ticker both-half significance during cheap discovery

BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION.confirmation: event-level blocked validation with multiplicity at confirmatory scope

SEASONALITY_SESSION_TIME.confirmation: fresh prospectively frozen follow-on; Epoch30 per-symbol winners may not be cherry-picked

CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING.confirmation: pooled/clustered cross-sectional inference; peer-set law is part of estimand

RELATIVE_VALUE_COINTEGRATION.confirmation: pair/basket formation frozen before outcome; dependence-aware validation

CROSS_MARKET_LEAD_LAG.confirmation: causal lag design and protected confirmation

CAUSAL_ML_PREDICTIVE_OR_STATE_MODEL.confirmation: walk-forward or protected temporal validation; model selection nested away from confirmation

REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED.confirmation: hierarchical or regime-aware blocked validation; avoid requiring each ticker to independently certify the regime effect

CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE.confirmation: blocked until current term-structure authority exists

statistical_policy.discovery: Use effect sizes, uncertainty, power and breadth. Multiplicity is controlled at the scientifically appropriate exploratory level; do not equate exploration with final confirmation.
statistical_policy.confirmation: Retain explicit false-positive control using predeclared family/hypothesis scope and suitable FWER/FDR or hierarchical control.
statistical_policy.power: Estimate effective independent sample size and expected power before imposing gates. If power is inadequate for economically interesting effects, acquire longer history, pool/hierarchically model valid units, or redesign the estimand prospectively.
statistical_policy.stability: Chronological halves are diagnostic evidence, not a mandatory universal discovery veto. Confirmatory stability requirements must match the intended regime/portfolio object.
statistical_policy.portfolio_level: When weak widespread effects are the economic object, predeclare pooled, hierarchical or portfolio-level inference instead of demanding independent ticker-by-ticker significance.

legal_paths: Broad family-level structural evidence may justify a fresh prospectively frozen follow-on mechanism question.
Observed per-symbol winners may not be used as outcome-driven candidate selection.
A prospectively selected independent/protected confirmation set may advance to economics only after cost, margin, concurrency and capital-use gates are frozen.
A null low-power screen does not establish mechanism exhaustion.
promotion_policy.epoch30_case: Treat the 28-of-41 Holm-supported session-activity result as family-level structural evidence. Design any follow-on from the family-level phenomenon and outcome-blind broker features; do not select the 28 observed winners as the economic panel.
